audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields state that Piercing Light out-ranges Rupture. It does not: Piercing Light is 500 range and Rupture is 950. The Culling is never mentioned anywhere in either layer. And the single most useful property of Relentless Pursuit is missing — Lightslinger attacks reduce its cooldown.
audit.why: The range claim inverts the lane. A Cho'Gath told his Q is out-ranged will never contest, when in fact Rupture reaches almost twice as far as Piercing Light; what actually out-ranges him is Lucian's basic attack against a 125-range melee, plus Ardent Blaze at 900. The Relentless Pursuit fact changes how you count: it is 16s at rank 1, but every Lightslinger double-shot shortens it, so counting seconds after a spent dash is unreliable — count his attacks instead. The Culling is 110s at rank 1 and 1400 range, which is the one Lucian cooldown long enough to actually plan around.
audit.corrected: Correct the range claim, add the Lightslinger cooldown-reduction on Relentless Pursuit, and put The Culling on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer scores Lucian ahead at Levels 1, 2, 3, 6 and 2+ items at 2/10 each, and the content win array gives Lucian five of seven rows. The packet chart gives Cho'Gath everything from Levels 4-5 onward, and the content whys already say so: 'you stabilize and out-farm his harass', 'the all-in is lethal at 6', 'his poke is just chip you heal back', 'your Rupture-Feral Scream lockdown kills him'.
audit.why: 53.83% over 574 games is a favoured lane. A chart that gives Lucian 2/10-rated dominance in five stages describes a matchup Cho'Gath loses badly, which is the opposite of the data and the opposite of the paragraphs on the same page. diffRating 8.5/10 and the 'Hard matchup' rating line have the same problem, and they already contradict the diff token 'FAV' sitting three fields above them.
audit.corrected: Chart becomes Lucian, Lucian, Skill, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath with ratings 2, 2, 5, 6, 7, 7, 7; diffRating 4/10; tone green to match diff FAV.

audit.whatIsWrong: Relentless Pursuit is named in a dozen fields with no number, and no other Lucian cooldown appears at all.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s and 445 range. Piercing Light is 9s at rank 1 falling to 5s. Ardent Blaze is 14s at rank 1 and 900 range. The Culling is 110s at rank 1. Cho'Gath's own Feral Scream is 11s at rank 1 — the number that matters, because a silenced Lucian cannot cast the dash he needs to leave.
audit.corrected: Put 16s (and its Lightslinger reduction), 110s and 11s into cooldowns, dosFull, loading and phases[4].

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] ('Burn W on nothing') and dontsFull[2] ('Fall behind on R stacks') both carry descriptions from other matchups.
audit.why: Both headings are the right mistakes for this lane; their bodies explain neither.
audit.corrected: Give W its 11s cooldown and its actual job here, and explain Feast stacks as permanent max health against a burst pattern.

edits.before: Lucian's Lightslinger double-tap and Piercing Light Q out-range your Rupture, so he chips you for free while you can only farm at melee — his strongest window.
edits.after: Piercing Light is only 500 against Rupture's 950 — it is his autos and the Lightslinger double-tap that out-range you, so farm at melee and eat the chip.

edits.before: Lucian's Lightslinger double-shot and Piercing Light Q out-range your Rupture and you have no sustain edge yet — he pokes you for free.
edits.after: His autos and the Lightslinger double-shot out-range you and you have no sustain yet — Piercing Light is only 500, but he never needs it.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are his lane, not yours — Lucian's Lightslinger double-shot and Piercing Light Q out-range your Rupture, and you have no sustain edge yet to trade it back. Don't walk up to throw a Q he can just Relentless Pursuit away from; last-hit at the tip of Rupture and eat the chip. The one thing keeping you healthy is Carnivore — once you have minions to last-hit, his poke can't out-pace your kill-heals, so soak it and wait for your kit to come online.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are his lane, not yours — his autos and the Lightslinger double-shot out-range you and you have no sustain edge yet to trade it back. Piercing Light is only 500 against Rupture's 950, so the tip of your Q does reach him; just don't walk up to throw one he can Relentless Pursuit out of. The one thing keeping you healthy is Carnivore — once you have minions to last-hit, his poke can't out-pace your kill-heals.

edits.after: - Relentless Pursuit: 16s at rank 1, but every Lightslinger double-shot cuts it — count his attacks, not seconds. - The Culling: 110s at rank 1, 1400 range. - Feral Scream: 11s, and it stops the dash.

edits.before: Track Lucian's Relentless Pursuit: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Q-knockup + Feast the kill.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1, but every Lightslinger attack shortens it — count his hits, not the clock.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

edits.before: - Cho'Gath vs Lucian - Track: Lucian Relentless Pursuit. - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage only on Relentless Pursuit's cooldown. - Don't chase past the wave. - Ultimate = kill windows only.
edits.after: - Cho'Gath vs Lucian - Track: Relentless Pursuit, 16s at rank 1, shortened by every Lightslinger hit. - Feral Scream stops the dash. - Levels 1-3 are his. - Feast stacks end it.

edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4/10. Survive levels 1-3 on Carnivore sustain; from levels 4-5 onward, Feast stacks decide the lane.

notes: FLAG MISFIRE, deliberately not written: champ-data/_kits/_missing/chogath.json says 'Lucian sustains through chip damage (Lightslinger (P)) — Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.' The heal flag on Lightslinger comes from the clause 'when Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally', which is an ally interaction with no bearing on a top-lane 1v1. Lightslinger itself heals nothing, so I proposed no anti-heal advice here — buying Bramble Vest into a solo-lane Lucian on that basis would be a wasted item slot. The packet suspectName 'Hold Relentless Pursuit' is a false positive; the page has the name right. Level chart: five rows flip in both layers as one atomic group, matching the packet and the content whys. Note the page already contradicted itself before this audit: diff reads 'FAV' while tone is red and diffRating is 8.5/10; I brought the last two into line with the first and with the 53.83% win rate.
